name: application-lesson-playlist
title: Lesson Playlist
description: Ordered course-lesson list with completed, in-progress, available, and locked states — distinct from application-task-checklist since lessons have a gated, ordered progression rather than freely toggleable items.
useWhen: Showing an ordered list of video or reading lessons within a course module.
Gating later lessons behind a locked state until earlier ones are completed.
Highlighting the current in-progress lesson distinctly from completed and upcoming ones.
avoidWhen: Items can be completed in any order with no gating — use application-task-checklist instead.
There is no real duration or lock semantics — a plain list or application-onboarding-checklist may be simpler.
The content isn't lesson/course-shaped — use application-tables or a generic list instead.
responsiveBehavior: The list has a fixed max width; lesson titles truncate with an ellipsis rather than wrapping so duration stays visible on one line.
accessibility: Each lesson is a real button element, with locked lessons carrying the disabled attribute so they cannot be activated.
Completed, current, and locked states are each communicated by an icon or badge plus text styling, not color alone.
The module header states the completed-of-total count in real text, not only through visual progress.

variants.title: Module list
variants.description: Course-module lesson list with a header showing completed-of-total count, and completed/current/available/locked row states.
accessibility: Locked lessons are real disabled buttons, not just visually dimmed clickable rows.

variants.title: Module list (Dark)
variants.description: Module-list lesson playlist adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Completed, current, and locked state colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Numbered with progress bar
variants.description: Compact numbered lesson list with a playback progress bar under the current in-progress lesson.
accessibility: The progress bar is supplementary to the lesson's visible current-state styling, not the only indicator of progress.

variants.title: Numbered with progress bar (Dark)
variants.description: Numbered lesson playlist with a progress bar, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Progress bar and lesson number badge contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
